'''Bright Sun Hill''', originally named the '''Jedi Hill Camp''', was a hill on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] near [[Redgill Lake]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] and the [[Broken Columns Clan]] was moved to the hill due to [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] attacks on the conclave.

Per Dathomiri tradition, the new camp, with its limited space, must be claimed and bear the standard of one faction; clan leaders [[Kaminne Sihn]] and [[Tasander Dest]] agreed with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]&ndash;in&ndash;[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] advice that the hill should be claimed as [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] territory in order to prevent conflicts between their two clans, with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ally [[Dyon Stadd]] quickly creating a standard resembling the [[Alliance Starbird]], crossed over by two Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. A member of each clan must also bear witness&mdash;Jedi [[Ben Skywalker]] chose [[Halliava Vurse]] and [[Drola Kinn]] of the Raining Leaves and Broken Columns, respectively. The trio thus joined Luke Skywalker and Dyon Stadd to the hill.

Midway through claiming the hill, Luke Skywalker realized that by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] decree, he was prevented from setting [[Foot/Legends|foot]] on any Jedi territory, and so asked Ben to claim the hilltop instead while he himself would head to the halfway point of the hill. However, Dathomiri custom also decreed that only the faction with the greater claim could set down the standard, and so Ben enlisted Stadd, a former Jedi candidate, as a consultant of the Order for five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. They then set up the standard and claimed the hill, with Ben Skywalker declaring it "Camp Jedi."

[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ben Skywalker, who initially claimed the hill for the Jedi]]
Shortly after the Dathomiri set up camp on the hill, it was [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|attacked]] by Nightsisters, who utilized several [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] that charged up the hill. Although each wave of assaults was repelled to significant casualties for the defenders, they adapted tactics mirroring those used in [[Navy/Legends|naval]] combat to help coordinate members of both clans, turning the tide of the battle against the Nightsisters. Luke Skywalker was nearly overwhelmed by them near the bottom of the hill, which bordered a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] in which the Nightsisters hid, but was saved by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] member [[Vestara Khai]], who was also a part of the Raining Leaves. In the aftermath of successfully deploying the new strategy, morale improved among the defenders, with Stadd jesting that their "[[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]," ''Hilltop'', held up well. The two clans then united to form the [[Bright Sun Clan]], with their standard replacing the Jedi's and the hill renamed Bright Sun Hill.

The surviving Nightsisters retreated and, as per a plan agreed between Khai and Halliava Vurse&mdash;who disagreed with the union of the clans and was secretly a Nightsister&mdash;gathered alongside the rest of their forces at a [[Dathomir landing meadow|landing meadow]] nearby, under [[Dresdema]]'s leadership. They sought to cooperate with the incoming Sith Tribe, but were instead [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|assailed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who slayed all of their rancors and took the remainder of the sisters [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] before leaving the scene, as they proved no match for the oncoming Jedi. The Bright Sun Clan arrived in the aftermath, learning of Khai and Halliava Vurse's treachery but grateful for the Jedi's intervention in warding off the Sith; Kaminne Sihn presented Ben Skywalker the deed to the Bright Sun Hill, intended for the Jedi Order, as she wished that they would establish a new school amidst their territory.
